ei.title: 패션의 규칙적 주기 — Kroeber의 여성 이브닝 드레스 연구
ei.subject: 9월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: 패션의 규칙적 주기 — Kroeber의 여성 이브닝 드레스 연구

fullPassage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, ①<u>stretching</u> back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having ②<u>adjusted</u> the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and ③<u>coming up with</u> a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He ④<u>reduced</u> women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ coming up with → to come up with: 'able to analyse ... and to come up with' 병렬.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stretching: 'stretching back about three centuries'는 연구를 부연하는 분사구문으로 정상이에요.
✅ ② adjusted: 'Having adjusted the dimensions'는 완료분사구문(주어 he가 조정의 주체)으로 정상이에요.
❌ ③ coming up with → to come up with: 'was able to analyse ... and ___ a study'에서 and는 앞의 to부정사(to analyse)와 같은 형태를 병렬해야 하므로 to come up with가 맞아요. 동명사 coming up with는 병렬이 깨져요. ←정답
✅ ④ reduced: 'He reduced women's clothing'은 과거형 동사로 정상이에요.
det.tip: A and B 병렬: to analyse ... and to come up with (to부정사끼리)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and ①<u>using</u> reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study ②<u>who was neither</u> intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He ③<u>demonstrated</u> unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms ④<u>reach</u> the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② who was neither → that was neither: 선행사가 사물(a study)이므로 that/which.
det.analysis:
✅ ① using: 'using reproductions of engravings'는 수단을 나타내는 분사구문으로 정상이에요.
❌ ② who was neither → that was neither: 'a study ___ was neither intuitive nor approximate'에서 선행사 a study는 사물이므로 관계대명사 that(또는 which)을 써야 해요. 사람에 쓰는 who는 틀려요. ←정답
✅ ③ demonstrated: 'He demonstrated unambiguously'는 과거형 동사로 정상이에요.
✅ ④ reach: 주어 forms(복수)에 맞춘 현재형 reach로 정상이에요.
det.tip: 선행사가 사물 → 관계대명사 that/which (who는 사람)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He ①<u>reduced</u> women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He ②<u>demonstrated</u> unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms ③<u>reach</u> the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years ④<u>after been long</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ after been long → after being long: 전치사 after 뒤에는 동명사.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reduced: 'He reduced women's clothing to a certain number of features'는 과거형 동사로 정상이에요.
✅ ② demonstrated: 'He demonstrated unambiguously that ~'는 과거형 동사로 정상이에요.
✅ ③ reach: 'forms reach the furthest point'는 복수주어 forms에 맞춘 현재형으로 정상이에요.
❌ ④ after been long → after being long: 전치사 after 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 being이 맞아요. been은 조동사 have 없이 전치사 뒤에 올 수 없어요. ←정답
det.tip: 전치사(after) + 동명사(being): after being short/long

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and ①<u>in-depth</u> study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but ②<u>precise</u>, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly ③<u>irregular</u> phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise ④<u>periodic</u> cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ irregular(불규칙한) → regular(규칙적인): 패션은 '규칙적인' 현상.
det.analysis:
✅ ① in-depth(심층적인): Kroeber의 '심층적인' 연구로 문맥상 적절해요.
✅ ② precise(정밀한): 직관적이지 않고 '정밀한' 연구라는 흐름에 맞아요.
❌ ③ irregular(불규칙한) → regular(규칙적인): 글 전체가 패션이 '규칙적인(regular)' 현상임을 증명하므로, '불규칙한'은 정반대예요. ←정답
✅ ④ periodic(주기적인): '정밀한 주기적 순환'으로 적절해요.
det.tip: 글의 핵심: fashion is regular(규칙적) ↔ irregular(불규칙)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a ①<u>rich</u> and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the ②<u>varying</u> elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but ③<u>precise</u>, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the ④<u>furthest</u> point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② varying(변하는) → constant(불변의): 패션의 '불변하는' 상수 요소.
det.analysis:
✅ ① rich(풍부한): '풍부하고 심층적인 연구'로 적절해요.
❌ ② varying(변하는) → constant(불변의): Kroeber가 분석한 것은 패션의 '불변하는(constant)' 상수 요소예요. '변하는 요소'는 상수(constant)라는 개념과 모순돼요. ←정답
✅ ③ precise(정밀한): 직관적이지 않고 '정밀한' 연구로 적절해요.
✅ ④ furthest(가장 먼): '변이의 가장 먼 지점에 도달한다'로 적절해요.
det.tip: constant elements(불변의 상수 요소) ↔ varying(변하는)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but __________. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 패션은 해마다가 아니라 on the scale of history(역사적 척도에서) 규칙적이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① at the level of annual variations (해마다의 변동 수준에서): 앞에 'not located at the level of annual variations'로 이미 부정된 쪽이에요.
✅ ② on the scale of history (역사적 척도에서): 'not at ~ but ___' 구조에서 해마다가 아니라 '역사의 척도'에서 규칙적이라는 대비가 맞아요. ←정답
❌ ③ in reproductions of engravings (판화 복제본에서): 연구 자료일 뿐 규칙성의 척도가 아니에요.
❌ ④ at the furthest point of design (디자인의 가장 먼 지점에서): 문맥상 어색한 표현이에요.
det.tip: not at the level of annual variations but ___ → 역사적 척도(on the scale of history)

ch: at the level of annual variations
at the furthest point of design

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 여성 의복은 300년간 a very precise periodic cycle(매우 정밀한 주기적 순환)을 따랐다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a very precise periodic cycle (매우 정밀한 주기적 순환): 바로 뒤 '50년마다 가장 먼 지점에 도달한다'는 설명이 주기적 순환을 뒷받침해요. ←정답
❌ ② a set of annual variations (해마다의 변동 묶음): 글은 해마다의 변동(annual variations)을 명시적으로 부정했어요.
❌ ③ a purely intuitive guess (순전히 직관적인 추측): 연구는 직관적이지 않고 정밀했어요.
❌ ④ a slow and permanent decline (느리고 영구적인 쇠퇴): 순환(cycle)이지 쇠퇴가 아니에요.
det.tip: 뒤 문장 'every fifty years ... furthest point' → 주기적 순환(periodic cycle)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 약 3세기에 걸친 여성 이브닝 드레스 연구.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 약 3세기 연구: 'stretching back about three centuries'와 일치해요. ←정답
❌ ② 직관적·대략적: 원문은 'neither intuitive nor approximate'로 그 반대예요.
❌ ③ 치마 길이 제외: 원문은 'length and size of the skirt'를 포함했어요.
❌ ④ 해마다 불규칙: 원문은 'regular ... on the scale of history'로 규칙적이에요.
det.tip: stretching back about three centuries = 약 3세기에 걸쳐

ch: Kroeber는 약 3세기에 걸친 서양 여성 이브닝 드레스를 연구했다.
그의 연구는 직관적이고 대략적인 방식에 의존했다.
그는 치마 길이를 측정 대상에서 제외했다.
그는 패션이 해마다 불규칙하게 변한다고 결론지었다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 50년 뒤는 가장 짧아지고, 100년 뒤 다시 길어진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 판화 복제본: 'using reproductions of engravings'와 일치해요.
✅ ② 몇 가지 특징으로 환원: 'reduced ... to a certain number of features'와 일치해요.
✅ ③ 50년마다 가장 먼 지점: 'reach the furthest point ... every fifty years'와 일치해요.
❌ ④ 50년 뒤 다시 가장 길어진다: 원문은 50년 뒤 가장 짧아지고(shortest), 100년 뒤 다시 길어진다고 했어요. ←정답
det.tip: longest → (50년) shortest → (100년) long again

ch: Kroeber는 판화 복제본을 연구 자료로 사용했다.
그는 여성 의복을 몇 가지 특징으로 환원했다.
패션 형태는 50년마다 변이의 가장 먼 지점에 도달한다.
치마가 가장 길면 50년 뒤 다시 가장 길어진다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 정밀·수학적·통계적 연구.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 같은 기원·조정 불필요: 원문은 'diverse origins'라 치수를 조정했어요(Having adjusted).
✅ ② 정밀·수학적·통계적: 'precise, mathematical and statistical'과 일치해요. ←정답
❌ ③ 해마다 변동: 원문은 해마다가 아니라 역사적 척도에서 규칙적이라고 했어요.
❌ ④ 어떤 규칙도 없음: 원문은 '매우 정밀한 주기적 순환'을 따랐다고 했어요.
det.tip: precise, mathematical and statistical = 정밀하고 수학적이며 통계적인

ch: 판의 치수는 모두 같은 기원을 가져 조정이 필요 없었다.
패션은 역사적 척도가 아니라 해마다 변동한다.
여성 의복은 300년간 어떤 규칙도 따르지 않았다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 패션 변화의 장기적 규칙성(주기) 발견.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 디자인 변천사: 변천'사' 나열이 아니라 '규칙성'을 다뤄요.
❌ ② 미술사 연구 방법: 판화는 자료일 뿐 주제가 아니에요.
✅ ③ 규칙적인 주기: Kroeber가 패션이 역사적 척도에서 정밀한 주기적 순환을 보인다는 것을 증명한 것이 핵심이에요. ←정답

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
